title: Current therapeutic landscape and future treatment perspectives of MASH.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Ran paper_context.py: Europe PMC flags show no open access, no PMC full text, no supplement, no data or database cross-references, no text-mined accessions; NCBI links empty; Zenodo/Dryad search on the DOI returned nothing.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: The abstract states this is a Review article summarising MASH (metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis, an inflammatory fatty-liver disease) drug trials and biomarkers; it describes no new dataset.

a1_downloadable.note: Narrative Review with no deposited data: no supplement, no accessions, no repository records found via Europe PMC, NCBI or Zenodo/Dryad. Paywalled, no PMC copy.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No table exists; any label (e.g. trial response) would have to be compiled by hand from cited trials, i.e. constructed.

a3_inputs_present.note: No data files; not checked further.

a5_enough_rows.note: No rows exist; a hand-compiled list of MASH trials would be tens to low hundreds of items at most (estimate, not counted).

honest_claim_h3: None: the paper is a narrative Review with no dataset to model.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use drug mechanism and trial design to predict whether a fatty-liver-disease drug trial improves liver scarring.
plain_idea.train_on: A hand-compiled list of MASH (inflammatory fatty-liver disease) clinical trials with drug class and patient features; number of examples unknown and likely under a few hundred.
plain_idea.predict: Whether the trial met its liver-biopsy endpoint (fibrosis improvement or MASH resolution), as reported in the trial publications the Review cites.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Could help prioritise drug classes, but the Review provides no data and the item count is far too small for ML.

ml_idea: None viable: Review article with no deposited data; a trial-outcome table would have to be built by hand and would be tiny.

effort.cheapest_killing_check: Europe PMC flags (no suppl, no data, no accessions) already kill it.

verdict_reason: Narrative Review of MASH (inflammatory fatty-liver disease) therapies with no deposited data, supplement or accessions; fails A1 (nothing to download) and A2 (any label would be hand-constructed).
